message: Supervised priority training aborted: Insufficient completed maintenance outcomes.

audit.decision_rationale: Completed repair count N=0 is below the statistical threshold (N>=50) required for supervised priority modeling. The database contains only 2 maintenance tasks and 0 completed repairs. Training a priority classifier on heuristic priority scores would create a circular proxy with no independent validation.
audit.prohibition_policy: CivicPulse AI strictly prohibits training ML priority models on rule-engine scores or synthetic data and claiming validated predictive performance.

recommended_action: Continue operating the explainable heuristic priority scoring engine as an administrative decision-support tool.
